name: California
overview: California offers an income-limited, flat nonrefundable renter credit.

programs.name: Nonrefundable renter's credit
programs.incomeDefinition: California adjusted gross income; filing-status rules apply.
programs.incomeLimits: 2025: $53,994 single/separate; $107,987 joint, head of household, or qualifying surviving spouse.
programs.maximumBenefit: $60 single/separate; $120 for other eligible filing statuses.
programs.formulaSummary: Fixed credit subject to eligibility and available state income-tax liability.
programs.application: Claim on the California income-tax return.
eligibilityNotes: Generally must pay California rent for at least half the year.
Tax-exempt housing, dependent status, and property-tax-exemption restrictions apply.

programs.name: Homeowners' exemption
programs.formulaSummary: Reduces taxable value before applying property-tax rates.
programs.application: One-time BOE-266 claim to county assessor.
eligibilityNotes: Owner's principal residence on January 1; full-exemption deadline generally February 15.

programs.name: Property Tax Postponement
programs.incomeDefinition: Program household income from the prior calendar year.
programs.incomeLimits: 2025–2026 filing period uses 2024 income no greater than $55,181.
programs.maximumBenefit: Approved current-year taxes deferred; must be repaid.
programs.formulaSummary: State advances tax payments, secured by a lien; this is a loan.
programs.application: Apply annually through State Controller during the published filing period.
eligibilityNotes: Principal residence, at least40% equity, and no reverse mortgage.

researchNotes: The nominal credit may exceed usable savings because it is nonrefundable.
Owner relief is represented as exemptions/deferrals rather than cash credits.
